::: {#exr-weights}

#### A weighted average chosen by the input

Take the query $\vq = (1, 0)$ and three keys with one value each:

| Key | Value |
|-----|------:|
| $(2, 0)$ | 10 |
| $(0, 2)$ | 20 |
| $(1, 1)$ | 30 |

What weighted average of the values do you get
when the weights are the [softmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/multiclass-logistic-regression.html#def-softmax) of the keys' [dot products](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/linear-algebra-vectors.html#def-dot-product) with $\vq$?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint
Score each key by its dot product with $\vq$, <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
then take the softmax of the three scores. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
:::

:::
